AboutPage.intro: Zero Technology publishes independent tech reviews, buying guides and comparisons for desk setups, gaming gear, PCs, monitors and audio — so you can buy the right product the first time.

mission.title: Why we do this
mission.p1: Tech shopping is full of ads, sponsored rankings and spec sheets that don't tell you what matters. It's hard to find a review that is clear about where its information comes from.
mission.p2: {site} was created to change that. Every review attributes its key specs to a named source, lists real pros and cons, and scores the product against the same criteria. Brands never pay for opinions or scores.
mission.p3: Our goal is simple: help you make a confident buying decision, wherever you shop.

AboutPage.valuesIntro: The principles behind every article we publish.

independent.title: Independent Scores
independent.desc: We never take money from brands or retailers in exchange for opinions or scores. Affiliate links do not affect product rankings.

consistent.title: One Set of Criteria
consistent.desc: Every product is scored out of 10 on the same 4 criteria: design, performance, battery & durability, and value — so you can compare fairly.

honest.title: We Name the Downsides
honest.desc: Every review lists sourced specs, clear pros and cons and the features a product doesn't have. Spot a mistake? Tell us and we'll fix it.

local.title: Built for Buyers Everywhere
local.desc: Model names, prices and warranties vary by country, so we point out regional differences and link to stores in several regions.

AboutPage.scoringIntro: Each product gets an overall score out of 10, based on the criteria below.

design.title: Design
design.desc: Build quality, materials, size, weight and how practical it is in everyday use.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: How well the product does its main job: speed, smoothness, display quality, accuracy.

battery.title: Battery & durability
battery.desc: Battery life (for battery-powered devices), expected durability and warranty terms, which vary by region.

value.title: Value
value.desc: What you get for the money, compared with similarly priced alternatives.

AboutPage.commissionBody: Some links on this website are affiliate links — we may earn a commission when you buy, at no extra cost to you. Commission rates, or whether a product has an affiliate link at all, never affect scores or rankings.
AboutPage.ctaBody: Want to write for {site}, partner with us on promotion, or just talk tech? We'd love to hear from you.

method.title: Hands-on tests vs. research roundups
method.intro: Every review carries one of two labels, shown at the top of the article:

tested.title: Hands-on tested
tested.desc: We used the product ourselves in daily work or play for at least a week. Photos in the article are our own; the score combines that experience with the specs.

compiled.title: Research roundup
compiled.desc: We have not used the product. The article is compiled from manufacturer specs, retailer listings and user and press reviews (sources are listed in the "Sources" section). Images are official manufacturer photos. The score reflects the specs and how consistent the sources are, not personal experience.

method.updated: Article details are re-checked regularly; the update date is shown at the top of each article. Prices in articles are rough reference ranges — use the buy button to see the exact current price on the marketplace.
